title: NonsmoothHiddenConvex.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of F=H∘c permits nonsmooth, nonconvex F, although H is convex and a global minimizer exists.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Hidden convexity through an unknown differentiable bi-Lipschitz homeomorphism c; the convex reformulation is not available to the algorithm.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each query x returns an IID stochastic pulled subgradient Z(x), with E[Z(x)]=g(x)=J(x)*s for some s∈∂H(c(x)). Only vector replies are available; no function values, transformation evaluations, or Jacobians are supplied.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform second-moment bound E‖Z(x)‖²≤G², which also bounds centered variance; samples are independent with identical marginals. No exponential-tail or almost-sure boundedness condition is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public parameters satisfy 0<μ≤Lc, LJ≥0, G,R,ε>0. The hidden map satisfies μ‖x−y‖≤‖c(x)−c(y)‖≤Lc‖x−y‖, Dc(x)=J(x), and ‖J(x)−J(y)‖≤LJ‖x−y‖. Localization is supplied by F(0)≤F(y) on ‖y‖=R. F,H,c,J,g remain hidden.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output X with integrable gap F(X)−F(xstar), where xstar is a global minimizer, and E[F(X)−F(xstar)]≤ε.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation includes algorithm randomness and the IID oracle stream. Oracle cost is a fixed budget, not an expected stopping-time cost.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Hidden convexity with an unavailable nonlinear transformation, stochastic pulled-subgradient access, and a sphere-based localization condition constitutes a specialized variant of stochastic optimization.

descriptionHtml:
Nonsmooth Hidden Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing F=H∘c on a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space E, where H:E→R is convex and c:E→E is a differentiable bi-Lipschitz homeomorphism with Lipschitz derivative. The objective F can be nonsmooth and nonconvex. A global minimizer x⋆ exists, and F(0)≤F(y) whenever ∥y∥=R, for a given radius R>0. The oracle returns independent-sample estimates of a subgradient of H pulled back through the adjoint derivative of c, with unbiased means and uniformly bounded second moments. For ε>0, the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E with integrable objective gap satisfying E[F(x¯)−F(x⋆)]≤ε, averaging over sampling and algorithm randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈EF(x). Write ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ for the inner product on E and ∥⋅∥ for its induced norm. Operator norms ∥⋅∥op are the induced operator norms. The parameters satisfy 0<μ≤Lc,LJ≥0,G>0,R>0,ε>0. The algorithm receives E, a measurable sample space Ω, and μ,Lc,LJ,G,R,ε; the functions F,H,c, their derivative field, and the oracle distribution are accessible only through the specified oracle replies.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Hidden convex structure). The function H:E→R is convex: for all u,v∈E and t∈[0,1], H((1−t)u+tv)≤(1−t)H(u)+tH(v). The map c:E→E is a homeomorphism, Fréchet differentiable at every point, with derivative J(x):E→E. For all x,y∈E, F(x)=H(c(x)),μ∥x−y∥≤∥c(x)−c(y)∥≤Lc∥x−y∥,∥J(x)−J(y)∥op≤LJ∥x−y∥.

Assumption 2 (Attainment and boundary condition). There exists x⋆∈E such that F(x⋆)≤F(x)for every x∈E. The objective also satisfies F(0)≤F(y)for every y∈E with ∥y∥=R.

Assumption 3 (Stochastic pulled subgradients). There is a field g:E→E such that, for every x∈E, some sx∈E satisfies H(c(x))+⟨sx,u−c(x)⟩≤H(u)for all u∈E,g(x)=J(x)∗sx, where J(x)∗ is the adjoint of J(x).

Let ν be a probability measure on Ω. The oracle map a:E×Ω→E is jointly measurable. For every x∈E, a(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable and ∥a(x,⋅)∥2 is integrable under ν, with Eξ∼ν[a(x,ξ)]=g(x),Eξ∼ν[∥a(x,ξ)∥2]≤G2. At call k, a query x∈E receives a(x,ξk). The measurable samples (ξk)k≥0 are independent with common law ν under a joint probability law Q on ΩN. The algorithm’s randomness is independent of this sample sequence.

Queries may be made at any point of E. After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must be measurable, its gap F(x¯)−F(x⋆) must be integrable, and it must satisfy EP[F(x¯)−F(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the joint law of the algorithm’s randomness and the oracle sample sequence.

comparisonHtml:
On a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, F=H∘c attains its minimum, H is finite convex, and c is a differentiable homeomorphism with μ∥x−y∥≤∥c(x)−c(y)∥≤Lc∥x−y∥ and LJ-Lipschitz Jacobian. Known R>0 satisfies F(0)≤F(y) on ∥y∥=R. Jointly measurable IID oracle samples satisfy ∫g(x,ω)dp(ω)=Dc(x)∗sx, sx∈∂H(c(x)), and ∫∥g(x,ω)∥2dp(ω)≤G2. The target is ∫[F(x^)−F(x⋆)]dP≤ε, with P the IID sampling law. Parameters satisfy 0<μ≤Lc, LJ≥0, G,ε>0.

Nonsmooth hidden convexity: NonsmoothHiddenConvex.
Result Oracle complexity Novelty Limitations
(1) NonsmoothHiddenConvexStochastic (Ours) (⋆⋆⋆) (review) O(Wlog3⁡(2+W))
(2) (Bhaskara et al. 2025), Thm. 5.4 O(1+G3R4Lc4ρ′μ4ε3); ρ′=max{LJ/μ,μ/(LcR2)}. Almost-sure bound ∥g∥≤G; two-sphere condition specialized to D1=0,D2=R. (1): ε−2 instead of ε−3 up to logarithms; gain when GR/ε≫log3⁡(2+W). For LJR≥μ, factor GLcR/(μεlog3⁡(2+W)). Only second moments required.
(3) SGD (Bubeck 2015), Thm. 6.1; affine special case LJ=0 O(1+G2R2/ε2) stochastic subgradients. (1): scope extends to nonlinear hidden maps; no rate improvement on LJ=0. (1) costs an extra (Lc/μ)3log3⁡(2+W) for LJ=0, ε<GR.
(4) (Fatkhullin et al. 2024), Thm. 2, Cor. 1 Not comparable: requires closed convex X and bounded convex c(X); the target has c(E)=E. (1) handles the global unconstrained problem. No bounded-domain reduction is supplied; rates are not comparable. (1) requires a global smooth homeomorphism and barrier radius; (4) permits constrained problems and nonsmooth maps.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint

open MeasureTheory Metric
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.NonsmoothHiddenConvex

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  [countableE : SecondCountableTopology E]
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  μ : ℝ
  Lc : ℝ
  LJ : ℝ
  G : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.linearE Params.finiteE Params.completeE
  Params.measurableE Params.borelE Params.countableE Params.measurableΩ

structure Instance (p : Params) where
  F : p.E → ℝ
  H : p.E → ℝ
  c : p.E ≃ₜ p.E
  J : p.E → p.E →L[ℝ] p.E
  g : p.E → p.E

def IsPulledSubgradient {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (H : E → ℝ) (c : E → E) (J : E → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : E → E) (x : E) : Prop :=
  ∃ s : E, (∀ u, H (c x) + ⟪s, u - c x⟫ ≤ H u) ∧
    ∀ v, ⟪g x, v⟫ = ⟪s, J x v⟫

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance := Instance
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput := id
  valid q := 0 < q.μ ∧ q.μ ≤ q.Lc ∧ 0 ≤ q.LJ ∧ 0 < q.G ∧ 0 < q.R ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q I O :=
    ∃ (oracle : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω)
      (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, x) seed => oracle x seed } ∧
    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
      (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    Measurable (Function.uncurry oracle) ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (oracle x) (p : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖oracle x ω‖ ^ 2) (p : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x, ∫ ω, oracle x ω ∂(p : Measure _) = I.g x) ∧
    (∀ x, ∫ ω, ‖oracle x ω‖ ^ 2 ∂(p : Measure _) ≤ q.G ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ x, I.F x = I.H (I.c x)) ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ I.H ∧
    (∀ x, HasFDerivAt I.c (I.J x) x) ∧
    (∀ x y, q.μ * ‖x - y‖ ≤ ‖I.c x - I.c y‖) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖I.c x - I.c y‖ ≤ q.Lc * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖I.J x - I.J y‖ ≤ q.LJ * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∀ x, IsPulledSubgradient I.H I.c I.J I.g x) ∧
    (∀ y, ‖y‖ = q.R → I.F 0 ≤ I.F y) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn I.F Set.univ xstar)
  successful q I output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn I.F Set.univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => I.F (output ω) - I.F xstar) (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, I.F (output ω) - I.F xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.NonsmoothHiddenConvex
